name: p3-stream-echo-qjs
description: Echo Component Model streams through a QuickJS guest

scripts.componentize: jco componentize echo.js --backend qjs --backend-qjs-stub-wasi --wit wit --world-name component --out p3-stream-echo-qjs.wasm
scripts.transpile: jco transpile p3-stream-echo-qjs.wasm --out-dir dist --name p3-stream-echo-qjs --async-mode jspi --strict
scripts.all: pnpm run componentize && pnpm run transpile && pnpm run demo && pnpm run test
